name: Build Hooks for Circle CI
description: Supports creating frontend environments connected to circle ci environments.
provides_plugins: circleci (FrontendEnvironment: Circle CI (V1) — uses site-wide API key via CircleCiManager)
circleciv2 (FrontendEnvironment: Circle CI (V2) — per-environment token, custom pipeline parameters)
ecosystem_note: Submodule of build_hooks. Adds two FrontendEnvironment plugins for CircleCI. 'circleci' (V1) triggers a build via CircleCI API v1.1 (POST project/github/{project}/build) using a site-wide API key from build_hooks_circleci.settings.circleci_api_key, passed as the ?circle-token= URL query parameter (CircleCiManager service). 'circleciv2' (V2) triggers a pipeline via API v2 (POST project/gh/{project}/pipeline) with a PER-ENVIRONMENT token stored on the environment entity, HTTP Basic auth, branch/tag reference, and arbitrary typed (string/boolean/integer) pipeline parameters; it also lists recent workflows on the deploy form. Secrets: V1 key and V2 token are stored plaintext in config and the V1 key is placed in the request URL — see security.md.
